description: This file defines the public interface for the OpenHome Camera API, including data structures, enums, and function prototypes for camera initialization, configuration, security, streaming, network, media, firmware updates, and other camera control operations.

methods.name: initOhcm
methods.description: Initializes the OpenHome Camera library; must be called before other functions.

methods.name: cleanupOhcm
methods.description: Cleans up internal resources created during initOhcm.

methods.name: setOhcmMutualTlsMode
methods.description: Enables or disables mutual TLS with the camera using provided certificate and key filenames.

methods.name: ohcmIsMtlsCapable
methods.description: Checks if mutual TLS is supported by the camera.

methods.name: ohcmSetTLSVerify
methods.description: Sets the TLS verification level for camera communication.

methods.name: ohcmGetTLSVerify
methods.description: Gets the current TLS verification level.

methods.name: createOhcmCameraInfo
methods.description: Creates a new ohcmCameraInfo object with NULL values.

methods.name: destroyOhcmCameraInfo
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmCameraInfo object and its contents.

methods.name: getOhcmDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves details about the camera device.

methods.name: isOhcmAlive
methods.description: Pings the camera to check if it is alive.

methods.name: createOhcmDeviceInfo
methods.description: Creates a new ohcmDeviceInfo object with NULL values.

methods.name: destroyOhcmDeviceInfo
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmDeviceInfo object and its contents.

methods.name: printDeviceInfo
methods.description: Prints the contents of an ohcmDeviceInfo object for debugging.

methods.name: createOhcmSecurityAccount
methods.description: Creates a blank ohcmSecurityAccount object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmSecurityAccount
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmSecurityAccount object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmSecurityAccountFromList
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmSecurityAccount object from a linked list.

methods.name: getSecurityAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves current security accounts from the camera.

methods.name: addSecurityAccounts
methods.description: Adds security accounts to the camera.

methods.name: deleteSecurityAccount
methods.description: Deletes a security account from the camera.

methods.name: createOhcmStreamCapabilities
methods.description: Creates a new ohcmStreamCapabilities object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmStreamCapabilites
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmStreamCapabilities object.

methods.name: getOhcmStreamCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves streaming capabilities from the camera.

methods.name: ohcmContainsCapability
methods.description: Checks if a capability exists in a list.

methods.name: createOhcmStreamChannel
methods.description: Creates a blank ohcmStreamChannel object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmStreamChannel
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmStreamChannel object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmStreamChannelFromList
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmStreamChannel object from a linked list.

methods.name: getOhcmStreamingChannels
methods.description: Retrieves current streaming channels from the camera.

methods.name: getOhcmStreamingChannelByID
methods.description: Retrieves a specific streaming channel configuration.

methods.name: setOhcmStreamingChannels
methods.description: Applies new streaming channel configurations to the camera.

methods.name: createOhcmUploadVideo
methods.description: Creates a blank ohcmUploadVideo object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmUploadVideo
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmUploadVideo object.

methods.name: uploadOhcmVideo
methods.description: Uploads a video clip to the camera.

methods.name: downloadOhcmPicture
methods.description: Downloads a picture from the camera.

methods.name: createOhcmConfigFile
methods.description: Creates a blank ohcmConfigFile object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmConfigFile
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmConfigFile object.

methods.name: getOhcmConfigFile
methods.description: Retrieves the full configuration from the camera.

methods.name: setOhcmConfigFile
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to the camera.

methods.name: createOhcmTimeConfig
methods.description: Creates a blank ohcmTimeConfig object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmTimeConfig
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmTimeConfig object.

methods.name: getOhcmTimeZoneInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the current timezone setting from the camera.

methods.name: ohcmConfigSetMutualTLS
methods.description: Configures mutual TLS with the camera for pairing.

methods.name: setOhcmTimeZoneInfo
methods.description: Sets the timezone on the camera.

methods.name: createOhcmNetworkInterface
methods.description: Creates a blank ohcmNetworkInterface object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmNetworkInterface
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmNetworkInterface object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmNetworkInterfaceFromList
methods.description: Destroys an ohcmNetworkInterface object from a linked list.

methods.name: getOhcmNetworkInterfaceList
methods.description: Retrieves network interface list from the camera.

methods.name: setOhcmNetworkInterface
methods.description: Configures a network interface on the camera.

methods.name: createOhcmWirelessStatus
methods.description: Creates a wireless status object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmWirelessStatus
methods.description: Destroys a wireless status object.

methods.name: getWirlessStatusOhcmCamera
methods.description: Retrieves wireless status from the camera.

methods.name: createOhcmMediaTunnelRequest
methods.description: Creates a media tunnel request object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmMediaTunnelRequest
methods.description: Destroys a media tunnel request object.

methods.name: startOhcmMediaTunnelRequest
methods.description: Starts a media tunnel session.

methods.name: stopOhcmMediaTunnelRequest
methods.description: Stops a media tunnel session.

methods.name: createOhcmUpdateFirmwareRequest
methods.description: Creates a firmware update request object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmUpdateFirmwareRequest
methods.description: Destroys a firmware update request object.

methods.name: startOhcmUpdateFirmwareRequest
methods.description: Initiates firmware update.

methods.name: createOhcmUpdateFirmwareStatus
methods.description: Creates a firmware update status object.

methods.name: destroyOhcmUpdateFirmwareStatus
methods.description: Destroys a firmware update status object.

methods.name: getOhcmUpdateFirmwareStatus
methods.description: Retrieves firmware update status.

methods.name: rebootOhcmCamera
methods.description: Reboots the camera.

methods.name: factoryResetOhcmCamera
methods.description: Resets the camera to factory defaults.
